description: This is a PHP unit test class for the PimReportDataAPI class within the OrangeHRM PIM plugin. It contains setup methods and test cases to verify the behavior of the API, including fetching data and handling unimplemented methods.

classes.name: PimReportDataAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for the PimReportDataAPI, testing methods for retrieving, creating, and deleting report data within the OrangeHRM PIM plugin.

methods.name: setUpBeforeClass
methods.description: Sets up test data before all tests run, populating database fixtures.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the 'getAll' method of PimReportDataAPI using different test cases.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Verifies that the delete method raises a 'not implemented' exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Verifies that the validation rule for delete raises a 'not implemented' exception.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Verifies that the create method raises a 'not implemented' exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Verifies that the validation rule for create raises a 'not implemented' exception.
